title: Design System: Life-Link Blood Bank Portal

display.purpose: Authoritative Egyptian clinical titles and welcome headers in Cairo font.

headline.purpose: Major section banners, clinical drawer headers, and workflow milestones.

title.purpose: Ledger column groups, requisition titles, and telemetry headings.

body.purpose: Standard requisition data, notes, and patient companion guidance in IBM Plex Sans Arabic.

label.purpose: Status indicators, timestamps, and tabular-nums counters.

shadows.name: elevation-rest
shadows.purpose: Standard resting border elevation for clinical cards and ledger containers.

shadows.name: elevation-overlay
shadows.purpose: Prominent layered shadow for modal dialogs and custody history flyouts.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Standard clinical transition for drawer entrances and status button states.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-urgency primary action button for confirming triage and approving blood allocations.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c92a2a; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b02222; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #8e1b1b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c92a2a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Governance Button
components.description: Authoritative midnight navy action button for non-urgent administrative workflows.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #0e2430; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #163647; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e2430; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Clinical Urgency Badge
components.description: High-contrast clinical status pill denoting emergency priority status.
components.css: .ds-badge-emergency { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fef2f2; color: #c92a2a; border: 1px solid #fecaca; font-family: 'Cairo', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Blood Group Badge
components.description: Standardized ABO/Rh clinical badge ensuring glanceable identification of blood units.
components.css: .ds-badge-blood-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 32px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: #0e2430; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Cairo', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Clinical Search Input
components.description: Dense data search input with hairline border and crimson focus ring.
components.html: <input type="search" class="ds-input-search" placeholder="Search Unit ID or hospital..." />
components.css: .ds-input-search { height: 36px; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; padding: 0 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #0c1e28; border: 1px solid #cbd5dc; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input-search:focus { border-color: #c92a2a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(201, 42, 42, 0.2); }

components.name: Dispatch Cadence Telemetry Tile
components.description: High-density status tile for top-of-page quick triage queues.
components.css: .ds-telemetry-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 64px; padding: 8px 14px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dde4e8; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Cairo', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-tile-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #c92a2a; } .ds-tile-value { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: #c92a2a; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin-top: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Life-Link is an operations-critical healthcare web portal designed for clinical transfusion officers, hospital physicians, lab technicians, and cold-chain dispatchers. The interface prioritizes life-safety speed, instant scanability under stress, uncompromising data fidelity, and seamless bilingual Arabic/English operation. The visual language rejects whimsical tech-startup decoration, aggressive gradients, decorative shadows, and playful micro-interactions that slow down emergency workflows. Instead, it embodies authoritative clinical serenity: a clean, off-white sterile canvas (#f7f9fa), deep midnight navy governance surfaces (#0e2430), crisp 1px borders (#dde4e8), and high-contrast medical alerts.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, High-Contrast Palette: Pure clinical white cards on cool canvas with deep midnight navy chrome and crimson triage alerts.
Bilingual Typographic Rigor: Cairo headings and IBM Plex Sans Arabic body paired with Plus Jakarta Sans.
Dense Operational Scanability: High-information-density ledgers with sticky headers and tabular figures (tabular-nums).
Strict Bidi Isolation: Zero layout corruption with DINs and tracking codes isolated via <bdi> tags.

rules.name: The Clinical Priority Rule
rules.body: Crimson (#c92a2a) is strictly reserved for primary triage actions, STAT emergency indicators, and blood bag identification. Never use it as general decorative trim or arbitrary link styling.

rules.name: The Status Tonal Pair Rule
rules.body: Every clinical status badge MUST pair an accessible foreground ink with its matching 8-10% tinted subtle background and soft border. Never display bare uncontained text for medical status.

rules.name: The Bidi Isolation Rule
rules.body: Any DIN (Donation Identification Number), unit tracking code, phone number, timestamp, or blood group symbol MUST be wrapped in <bdi> or assigned dir="ltr" / unicode-bidi: isolate to guarantee zero punctuation flipping in Arabic context.

rules.name: The Tabular Precision Rule
rules.body: All quantities, timestamps, barcode digits, and blood bag volume counters must render with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to ensure scannable, rock-solid column alignment.

rules.name: The Hairline Clarity Rule
rules.body: Boundaries between clinical cards and ledger columns are drawn with 1px hairline borders (var(--border)), never floating drop shadows. Shadows appear strictly on elevated interactive overlays.

rules.name: The Restrained Radius Rule
rules.body: Radii never exceed 8px for structural surfaces. Pill shapes are reserved exclusively for blood group indicators and status badges.

dos: Do isolate every DIN, unit ID, and tracking code with <bdi dir="ltr"> to prevent Arabic bidirectional number flipping.
Do format all dates, timestamps, and numbers using tabular-nums.
Do keep action buttons concise with explicit verbs (Acknowledge request, Confirm allocation, Dispatch courier).
Do maintain a strict 4.5:1 text-to-background contrast ratio for all secondary clinical metadata.
Do preserve 1px hairline borders on cards and table cells for clarity under harsh fluorescent hospital lighting.
donts: Don't use Medical Crimson (#c92a2a) for decorative or neutral elements; its urgency value must never be diluted.
Don't mix conflicting font families across RTL and LTR viewports.
Don't use decorative drop shadows or soft-blur glow halos on static data tables.
Don't allow blood bag component technical database keys (blood_bag) to leak to the UI; always format using clinical component nomenclature.
Don't hide critical clinical status behind unrevealed tooltips or buried menus.
